# netactuate_dedicated_server_buy_build (Resource)

Purchases and deploys a dedicated server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_dedicated_server_buy_build" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `build_script` (String) Build script content to run during deployment.
- `device_id` (Number) Dedicated device ID to purchase.
- `disklayout` (Number) Dedicated disk layout ID.
- `fqdn` (String) Fully qualified domain name to assign during deployment.
- `mbpkgid` (Number) Dedicated server package ID.
- `profile` (Number) Dedicated OS profile ID to deploy.
- `root_password` (String, Sensitive) Root password to set during deployment.
- `ssh_key` (String) SSH public key content to install during deployment.
- `ssh_key_id` (Number) SSH key ID to install during deployment.

### Read-Only

- `build_id` (Number) Build job ID returned by the API.
- `build_status` (String) Build status returned by the API.
- `canceling` (Number) Canceling flag as returned by the API.
- `datacenter_id` (Number) Datacenter ID.
- `dedicated_server_id` (Number) Dedicated server ID from the API field named id.
- `hostname` (String) Dedicated server hostname.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ipmi_pubip` (String) IPMI public IP address.
- `ipmi_status` (Number) IPMI status as returned by the API.
- `ipmi_status_time` (String) IPMI status timestamp.
- `location` (String) Location name.
- `locked` (Number) Lock flag as returned by the API.
- `locked_msg` (String) Lock message, or empty when the API returns null.
- `nps_installed` (Number) NPS installed flag as returned by the API.
- `nps_os` (String) Installed NPS OS name.
- `package_status` (String) Package status.
- `primary_ipv4` (String) Primary IPv4 address.
- `primary_ipv6` (String) Primary IPv6 address, or empty when the API returns null.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_dedicated_server_buy_build.example 12345
```
